description: Governors Office - Western Province - The Western Provincial Business Names Statute of Trade Corporations and Non-Incorporated Trade Institutions No. 05 of 2011
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the establishment of new rules and regulations regarding business name registration fees and forms under the Western Provincial Business Names Statute. It contains legal/regulatory provisions including fee structures, form requirements, and repeal of previous gazette notifications, making it a clear example of Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5). While it mentions the Governor's name, this is in an official capacity to announce regulatory changes rather than constituting a personnel appointment with detailed portfolio responsibilities.
